function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure! Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on what’s convenient for you:

| Option | What it offers | How to order | Tips |
|--------|----------------|--------------|------|
| **Online cake‑delivery platforms** | Nationwide selection of bakeries, custom designs, same‑day delivery in many cities | Visit sites like **Etsy**, **Goldbelly**, **Cake Delivery**, **Bakery.com**, or local services such as **Peach & Co.** (NYC), **The Cake Shop** (London), **Cake & Co.** (Sydney). | Search “cake delivery near me” or add your city to filter local options. |
| **Local bakeries with online ordering** | Fresh, often handmade cakes; you can pick up or have them delivered | Google “bakery + [your city] + online ordering” or check the bakery’s website. Many have a “Place an Order” button. | Call ahead if you need a special flavor or size. |
| **Grocery chains** | Convenient, often free delivery with grocery pickup | Check the grocery app (e.g., **Walmart Grocery**, **Kroger**, **Tesco**, **Aldi**) for a “Bakery” section. | Some chains offer “Same‑Day” or “Next‑Day” delivery. |
| **Specialty cake shops** | Custom cakes, themed designs, premium ingredients | Look up specialty shops like **Baker & Spice**, **The Cake Boss**, or local artisan bakeries. | Provide a clear brief (size, flavor, theme) and ask about lead time. |
| **Meal‑delivery services** | Some services (e.g., **Blue Apron**, **HelloFresh**) include dessert options | Browse their dessert menu or contact customer support. | Great if you’re already using the service. |

### Quick steps to place an order

1. **Decide on the type of cake** (birthday, wedding, custom design, dietary restrictions).  
2. **Choose a provider**: use one of the options above or search “cake delivery + [your city]”.  
3. **Select the cake**: pick size, flavor, frosting, decorations.  
4. **Add any extras**: candles, personalized messages, gift wrapping.  
5. **Enter delivery details**: address, time window, contact number.  
6. **Pay**: most sites accept credit cards, PayPal, or Apple Pay.  
7. **Confirm**: you’ll receive an email/SMS confirmation and a tracking link if available.

### If you’re in a specific city

Let me know your city or zip code, and I can pull up the best local options for you!
